newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury plans indexed notes auction Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury plans indexed notes auction Jan 29.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury Monday said it plans to hold its first auction of index-linked notes on January 29.
In a statement, the Treasury said it anticipated that the official offering announcement will be released January 21.
The new notes will be issued Feb 6 and dated Jan 15, the Treasury said.
It gave no details on the size of the offering, but said complete information will be provided in the official offering announcement.
Treasury also said that the January reference consumer price index numbers and the daily index ratios would be released on Tuesday, December 31.

In the final rule released by the Department, Treasury said it had been urged during the comment period that it publish both the reference CPI for at least the three preceding months and the daily index ratios on a month-to-month basis.
"Treasury will support the request," the final rule stated, adding that it intends to provide monthly the daily reference CPI numbers and the daily index ratios "on a pilot basis for one year."
Deputy Assistant Treasury Secretary Roger Anderson told reporters that the first auction would be a 10-year note but that no decision on the maturity size of the second security had yet been decided.
